links.comparator_used: Pre-implementation tele-stroke usual-care workflow before Methinks Stroke Suite AI outputs were shared with vascular neurologists.
links.outcome: Primary workflow outcome: time from local stroke centre arrival to EMS transfer request.
links.effect: 59 [43–88] vs 61 [46–99] min; adjusted median difference: −2.40 min; 95% CI, −6.16 to 4.48.
links.tradeoff: Post-implementation local CTA acquisition increased from 28% (n = 33) to 81% (n = 111); NCCT predictions had processing errors in 5 cases (4%) and CTA outputs were unavailable in 2 cases (2%) due to processing errors.
links.quote: Time from arrival at the local-SC to EMS transfer request did not differ significantly between the pre- and post-implementation cohorts (59 [43–88] vs 61 [46–99] min; adjusted median difference: −2.40; 95% CI, −6.16 to 4.48) ( Figure 2A ).

design_hint: AI LVO detection integrated into tele-stroke workflow with remote neurologist final decision
